assets.dataset: ImageNet-1K original train; 256 ADM center crop + random flip

changes: Video DiT replaced by common image DiT; omit temporal pyramid/autoregressive history/text conditioning.

Replace author VAE/latent scale with shared SD-VAE-ft-ema. Both implementations build the spatial pyramid after VAE encoding; integer2x bilinear and block-average downsampling have the same averaging operator.
Retain spatial flow endpoints, correlated transition noise and author network-clock mapping.
Explicit native_psd boundary uses a PSD square root for the author singular gamma=1/3 covariance; original Cholesky is undefined. Same noise law, coupled CPU draws.

User-selected RDD rule: visit every training phase for each image; sum phase mean losses with coefficient1, no 1/K or stage-probability factors; one optimizer/EMA update after microbatch accumulation. This intentionally changes the author outer training objective/estimator.
Fix nominal stage_range to0/.3/.6/1 for legacy RDD-FM v2 comparison; retain PF corrected boundary clock, endpoints, author network clock and noise law.
Euler81/81/90 yields252 NFE, matching legacy RDD-FM Euler80/80/90 plus two endpoint calls; retain author-position policy.

Single-process FP32, micro1/accumulation256 is a memory-conservative default. Record changes to microbatch, numerical reduction and hardware; historical8-rank bitwise training equality is not claimed.
common_contract: Common ImageNet-256 class conditioning, SD-VAE-ft-ema, shared DiTMultiRes-XL/2 backbone, AdamW and 400K updates.
Equal data exposure is fixed; equal updates are NOT equal FLOPs. Record training compute/time and compare inference quality versus measured cost.
This frontend uses one process, micro32 and accumulation8 for global256. Historical RDD used 8 ranks x32; RNG/data order and FP summation are not claimed identical.
Main files are preregistered starting candidates, not already tuned best-performing configurations.
comparison.selection: Use validation data and an equal tuning-compute budget; do not select on final test scores.
comparison.evaluation: Primary CFG=1; 50K generated RGB, same ADM reference and preprocessing. Metrics are a separate evaluation step.
comparison.runtime_scope: Single-process single visible GPU or CPU; choose device externally; no multi-GPU DDP in this runner.

position.scope: Author FLUX axis RoPE with T=1 and no history: local integer spatial coordinates. Head64 axes16/24/24 become head72 axes16/28/28 to fit the common DiT; this dimension adaptation is not an author configuration.

training_aggregation.name: rdd_sum_stage_means
training_aggregation.noise_policy: Existing declared process noise coupling retained; this change concerns aggregation only
